sql: SELECT ticker, COUNT(*) AS filing_count FROM filing_metrics GROUP BY ticker
SELECT form_type, COUNT(*) AS filing_count FROM filing_metrics GROUP BY form_type
SELECT fiscal_year, COUNT(*) AS filing_count FROM filing_metrics WHERE fiscal_year BETWEEN 2022 AND 2025 GROUP BY fiscal_year
SELECT fiscal_period, COUNT(*) AS filing_count FROM filing_metrics GROUP BY fiscal_period
SELECT state_of_incorporation, COUNT(*) AS filing_count FROM filing_metrics WHERE state_of_incorporation != '' GROUP BY state_of_incorporation

SELECT CASE WHEN m.sic_description LIKE '%Computer%' OR m.sic_description LIKE '%Software%' OR m.sic_description LIKE '%Semiconductor%' THEN 'Technology' WHEN m.sic_description LIKE '%Retail%' THEN 'Retail' WHEN m.sic_description LIKE '%Bank%' THEN 'Financial' WHEN m.sic_description LIKE '%Petroleum%' THEN 'Energy' WHEN m.sic_description LIKE '%Pharmaceutical%' THEN 'Healthcare' WHEN m.sic_description LIKE '%Motor%' THEN 'Automotive' ELSE 'Other' END AS industry_family, COUNT(*) AS filing_count FROM filing_metrics m GROUP BY industry_family
SELECT ticker, AVG(revenue_usd) AS avg_revenue FROM filing_metrics WHERE revenue_usd IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ticker
SELECT form_type, AVG(net_income_usd) AS avg_net_income FROM filing_metrics WHERE net_income_usd IS NOT NULL GROUP BY form_type
SELECT fiscal_year, AVG(assets_usd) AS avg_assets FROM filing_metrics WHERE fiscal_year BETWEEN 2022 AND 2025 AND assets_usd IS NOT NULL GROUP BY fiscal_year
SELECT fiscal_period, AVG(operating_cash_flow_usd) AS avg_ocf FROM filing_metrics WHERE operating_cash_flow_usd IS NOT NULL GROUP BY fiscal_period
SELECT ticker, MAX(revenue_usd) AS max_revenue FROM filing_metrics WHERE revenue_usd IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ticker
SELECT state_of_incorporation, AVG(net_income_usd) AS avg_net_income FROM filing_metrics WHERE state_of_incorporation != '' AND net_income_usd IS NOT NULL GROUP BY state_of_incorporation

SELECT CASE WHEN m.sic_description LIKE '%Computer%' OR m.sic_description LIKE '%Software%' OR m.sic_description LIKE '%Semiconductor%' THEN 'Technology' WHEN m.sic_description LIKE '%Retail%' THEN 'Retail' WHEN m.sic_description LIKE '%Bank%' THEN 'Financial' WHEN m.sic_description LIKE '%Petroleum%' THEN 'Energy' WHEN m.sic_description LIKE '%Pharmaceutical%' THEN 'Healthcare' WHEN m.sic_description LIKE '%Motor%' THEN 'Automotive' ELSE 'Other' END AS industry_family, AVG(revenue_usd) AS avg_revenue FROM filing_metrics m WHERE revenue_usd IS NOT NULL GROUP BY industry_family
SELECT form_type, SUM(CASE WHEN net_income_usd > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS profitable_filings FROM filing_metrics WHERE net_income_usd IS NOT NULL GROUP BY form_type
SELECT fiscal_year, MAX(assets_usd) AS max_assets FROM filing_metrics WHERE fiscal_year BETWEEN 2022 AND 2025 GROUP BY fiscal_year
SELECT ticker, AVG(operating_cash_flow_usd) AS avg_ocf FROM filing_metrics WHERE operating_cash_flow_usd IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ticker
SELECT fiscal_period, AVG(revenue_usd) AS avg_revenue FROM filing_metrics WHERE revenue_usd IS NOT NULL GROUP BY fiscal_period

SELECT CASE WHEN m.state_of_incorporation = 'DE' THEN 'Delaware' WHEN m.state_of_incorporation != '' THEN 'other_state' END AS state_family, COUNT(*) AS filing_count FROM filing_metrics m GROUP BY state_family
SELECT ticker, MIN(net_income_usd) AS min_net_income FROM filing_metrics WHERE net_income_usd IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ticker

SELECT CASE WHEN m.sic_description LIKE '%Computer%' OR m.sic_description LIKE '%Software%' OR m.sic_description LIKE '%Semiconductor%' THEN 'Technology' WHEN m.sic_description LIKE '%Retail%' THEN 'Retail' WHEN m.sic_description LIKE '%Bank%' THEN 'Financial' WHEN m.sic_description LIKE '%Petroleum%' THEN 'Energy' WHEN m.sic_description LIKE '%Pharmaceutical%' THEN 'Healthcare' WHEN m.sic_description LIKE '%Motor%' THEN 'Automotive' ELSE 'Other' END AS industry_family, AVG(assets_usd) AS avg_assets FROM filing_metrics m WHERE assets_usd IS NOT NULL GROUP BY industry_family
